title: Alternative Firing with Guest Instructor: Bob Green
source_quote: Alternative Firing withGuest Instructor: Bob Green Fri., October 23 - Sun., October 25 Explore Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, and Horse Hair firing. Discover the rich textures and striking crackle effects of the Obvara method, also known as Baltic Raku.
